description: This file implements the discovery mechanism for Wide Area Gateways in a network using DNS Service Discovery (mDNS/SD) with Tailscale integration. It contains data structures for gatewaay beacons, functions to perform network scans, DNS queries via subprocess, and parsing of DNS/JSON responses to identify and collect gateway information.

classes.name: WideAreaGatewayBeacon
classes.description: Data structure representing a wide-area gateway with attributes such as instance name, display name, host, port, and optional LAN host, tailnet DNS, gateway port, SSH port, and CLI path.

classes.name: DiscoveryContext
classes.description: Context structure encapsulating functions to get Tailscale status and perform DNS lookups, with a static 'live' instance.

methods.name: discover
methods.description: Main function to discover wide-area gateways within a specified timeout, using the provided context, returning an array of Beacon objects.

methods.name: collectTailnetIPv4s
methods.description: Extracts and filters IPv4 addresses associated with the Tailscale tailnet from the Tailscale JSON status.

methods.name: readTailscaleStatus
methods.description: Attempts to read the Tailscale status JSON via various possible executable paths.

methods.name: loadWideAreaPtrRecords
methods.description: Performs DNS PTR record lookup for gateways within the specified domain, respecting remaining time budget.

methods.name: runDig
methods.description: Wrapper around the run method to execute 'dig' command with specified arguments and timeout.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Executes an external process with given path and arguments, captures and returns its output within a timeout.

methods.name: parseSrv
methods.description: Parses the DNS SRV record output to extract host and port.

methods.name: parseTxtTokens
methods.description: Parses TXT record lines from dig output to tokens, handling escaped characters.

methods.name: unescapeTxt
methods.description: Unescapes DNS TXT record escape sequences in a string.

methods.name: mapTxt
methods.description: Converts an array of TXT tokens into a key-value dictionary, decoding escape sequences.

methods.name: parseInt
methods.description: Converts a string to an integer if possible.

methods.name: isTailnetIPv4
methods.description: Checks if an IP address belongs to the tailnet, based on specific octet ranges.

methods.name: decodeDnsSdEscapes
methods.description: Decodes DNS Service Discovery escape sequences in a string to UTF-8.
